definition.name: Class
definition.description: A class or camp from Artists for Kids. It lists on its programme page, with a link to its own registration page, and leaves the list after its last day.

fieldDefinitions.name: Programme page
fieldDefinitions.description: The page that lists it: After School Art, Spring & Summer Day Camps or Paradise Valley Summer Camps.

fieldDefinitions.name: Listed under
fieldDefinitions.description: The heading it is listed under, the same for every class in the group. For example: Fall 2026 classes, or Pro D day camps.

fieldDefinitions.name: Description
fieldDefinitions.description: As on the district's page. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

fieldDefinitions.name: When
fieldDefinitions.description: As the team writes it. For example: 8 Tuesdays from Oct. 13 to Dec. 1

fieldDefinitions.name: Last day
fieldDefinitions.description: The class leaves the list the day after.

fieldDefinitions.name: For
fieldDefinitions.description: Grades or ages. For example: Grades 3-5

fieldDefinitions.name: Where
fieldDefinitions.description: One line for each part. For example: Boundary Elementary, then Room 011.

fieldDefinitions.name: Places
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional. The most it takes, for example 18.

fieldDefinitions.name: Status
fieldDefinitions.description: Open shows the Register button. Full, Waitlist, Opens soon and Closed say so. Change it the moment the class fills, in the same sitting as on the district's page.

fieldDefinitions.name: Registration opens
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional. Shown with the status Opens soon.

fieldDefinitions.name: Registration link
fieldDefinitions.description: The class's own registration page on the district's site.
